_comment: Booster cards (Zone C). A booster is ARMED when placed and only works on the NEXT turn. timing: 'nextPlayerTurn' (your next action) or 'nextEnemyTurn' (the enemy's next attack). appliesTo = which actions it modifies: attack, raw, energy, recharge, actionCard, turnStart, enemyAttack.

boosters.name: Double Strike
boosters.text: x2 damage on your next Attack.

boosters.name: Armor Breaker
boosters.text: Halves the enemy's Defense for your next attack.

boosters.name: Overcharge
boosters.text: x1.5 Energy from your next Recharge.

boosters.name: Power Surge
boosters.text: x1.5 damage on your next Raw Attack or Energy Attack.

boosters.name: Energy Siphon
boosters.text: Your next attack heals you for 50% of the damage dealt.

boosters.name: Eco Shield
boosters.text: Halves the damage of the enemy's next attack.

boosters.name: Efficiency Core
boosters.text: Your next Action Card costs 15 Energy instead of 25.

boosters.name: Second Wind
boosters.text: Next turn: Recharge restores x2 and heals 10 HP, but you cannot attack that turn.

boosters.name: Glass Cannon
boosters.text: x3 damage on your next Attack, but you take x1.5 damage from the enemy's next attack.

boosters.name: Clear Skies
boosters.text: Next turn, ignore the active Scenario's penalties on you.
